title: Paginate with validation
prompt:
Implement paginate() in api.py.

Signature: paginate(items, page, per_page) -> dict

Return a dict with keys: items (the slice), page, per_page, total, pages, has_next, has_prev.
pages = ceil(total / per_page), and 0 when total == 0.
has_next is True when page < pages; has_prev is True when page > 1 and pages > 0.

Validation (raise ValueError with a message containing the field name):
- page < 1 is invalid
- per_page < 1 or per_page > 100 is invalid
- a page beyond the last page is valid and returns an empty items list

Do not mutate the input list.
